notes: Imran asks Aisha, who sends him to Ibn Abbas, who sends him to Ibn Umar: only Ibn Umar relays a saying, so Aisha and Ibn Abbas are in the scene and are not links.

«وقال عبد الله بن رجاء حدثنا حرب عن يحيى حدثني عمران. وقص الحديث» is a second isnad for the same story naming a different transmitter: a variant group. The editor gloss «يعني عمر بن الخطاب» is left out.
